entities.name: PMID:25429648
observations: Human bronchial epithelial culture study reports apical sPLA2 secretion from ciliated-enriched cells and mucin/cysteinyl leukotriene responses in goblet-enriched cells.

entities.name: Airway sPLA2 cell findings
observations: Ciliated-enriched human bronchial cultures expressed sPLA2-IIA, -V, and -X and secreted sPLA2 apically; goblet-enriched cultures showed no comparable expression or secretion.

Exogenous sPLA2 induced cysteinyl leukotriene release from goblet-enriched cultures, with the strongest response to sPLA2-V; sPLA2-V increased mucin secretion, and lipoxygenase or cyclooxygenase inhibitors reduced the mucin response.
The available evidence does not directly trace endogenous ciliated-cell sPLA2 to the goblet-cell responses; measured eicosanoid output was cysteinyl leukotriene release.
